Please tell a friend about my site so we can all “live life better for less” together. You can also find out first about the latest and greatest bargains when you follow Alicia’s Deals on Instagram and “like” Alicia’s Deals on Facebook.
Here are my TOP TEN birthday freebies and deals that I DEFINITELY plan on taking advantage of in 2026:
1. Nothing Bundt Cakes: Join their free eClub, and they’ll email you a coupon for a COMPLETELY free bundlet around your birthday (you have a few weeks to redeem). Everyone needs a birthday cake, and this one is particularly delicious (I highly recommend the white chocolate raspberry flavor).
2. Changing Hands: The Tempe AND the Phoenix locations offer a $10 freebie the month of your birthday. Just bring your ID and get a new book!
3. Benihana: Sign up with their free Friends With Benefits program and get a free $50 birthday reward the month of your birthday. They also offer deals at RA Sushi, Kona Grill, and other great restaurants.

5. Kendra Scott: Sign up for their free Insider program and get 50% off any fashion jewelry item the month of your birthday (or 25% off fine jewelry). They also have a special bonus treat deal (totally optional).
6. Sephora: Sign up for their free Beauty Insiders program and enjoy a FREE gift for your bday! There are always several options to choose from.
7. Ulta: Sign up for their free Beauty Rewards program and enjoy a FREE gift on your bday!
8. Harkins Theatres: Join their free Harkins Awards program to get a free $5 birthday treat on your account for popcorn, drinks, snacks, and other treats.
9. Starbucks: Join their free Starbucks Rewards program and get a free drink or food item loaded to your account for your birthday. NOTE: You must join the program at least 7 days prior to your birthday to qualify for the freebie, and you must make at least one star-earning transaction throughout the year.
10. Black Rock Coffee: Join their FREE Black Rock Rewards program and get a free medium hot or iced drink within 30 days of their birthday. BONUS: You'll also get a free medium drink NOW for joining!

AMC Theatres: Join their free AMC Stubs program to get a free large popcorn loaded to your account for your birthday (you'll also get 50% off tickets EVERY Tuesday and Wednesday)!
Bashas': Join the birthday club and get lots of fun deals. Kids 10 and under even get a free cake! Thanks, Carla!

Dutch Bros: Join the free Dutch Rewards program and add your birthday to get a free drink. You'll also get a free medium drink now for joining.
Jersey Mike's: Join their free Mike's birthday rewards program and get a free sub on your birthday (you must have bought a sub sometime the year before).
Joe's Farm Grill: Stop in on your birthday for a free meal with ID. Joe's Real BBQ gives a free meal on your birthday too (up to $10).
Kabuki: Join their Red Mask Club and get $15 off your check for your birthday along with lots of other deals! Thanks, Trisha!
Kohl's: Join their free rewards program and get a $5 Kohl's Cash gift for your birthday (you must have made at least one purchase to get this perk).
Red Robin: Join their free Royalty program to get a free burger for your birthday (must have spend $10+ during the year). You get a free appetizer for joining.
Total Wine: Join their free rewards program and share your birthday to get a free bottle of wine perk via email the week before your birthday. (Thanks so much for this one Anne, I think this will definitely make Top 10 next year)!

"Highlights
☘ Held annually in downtown Phoenix, the St Patrick's Parade and Faire features live Irish music, step dancing, bagpipers, and vendors ☘
About This Deal
What's included: one, two, or four single-day admission tickets to the Faire

The streets of Phoenix run green each year as the annual St. Patrick's Day Parade & Faire lures crowds seeking a celebration of Irish and Irish-Arizonan culture. First held in 1984, the parade fills 3rd Street with a procession that includes marching bands, Irish step dancers, floats, bagpipers, and the Queen of the Parade—this year's Arizona Irish Colleen Pageant champion.
Parade begins at 10 a.m.

Bands and dance troupes occupy the fair's three stages, entertaining crowds with live performances.
Faire will be open 10:00 a.m.–5 p.m. at Margaret T. Hance Park on the east side.
Two stages of Irish entertainment: local Irish bands, Irish dancers, bagpipers, poets, and more
Food and beverage: Irish beers and Busker's Irish Whiskey, traditional St. Patrick's Day corned beef and cabbage, shepherd's pie, fish and chips, BBQ

posts.title: FREE 10-Minute Test That Might Help You Understand Yourself and Important People Around You Better!
posts.excerpt: I truly believe that when we understand where people close to us are coming from, we'll get along better and live happier lives. This week my daughter…
posts.text:
I truly believe that when we understand where people close to us are coming from, we'll get along better and live happier lives. This week my daughter volunteered to be a part of an AP research project for a teammate. Each volunteer took a free 10-minute personality test (in case you're curious, the purpose of the project is to measure if one personality type is best at learning choreography quickly).
After she took the test, I decided to take it too (you can check it out here). I remember taking the same test several years ago and re-taking it was very helpful. My personality type is ESFJ (there are 16 unique types). My daughter's type is different from mine and the descriptions of why we do things the way we do were spot on. We already get along very well, but it's so helpful as a parent to remember that people look at the world through different lenses. I have to get the rest of my family to take it now!
This is not a diagnosis by any means and I’m not affiliated with their site, I just really appreciated the information and think it can help me be a better parent, wife, sister, friend, etc.! I hope this free test helps you understand yourself and the people most important to you too! I'm all about self-improvement in 2022!
Enjoy!

posts.title: Have You Heard About Supercuts Training Studios? Free Haircuts/Color!
posts.excerpt: Update: Check out the comment I just got from Alicia's Deals reader Garrett: "Just had my hair cut by Stephanie. She did a wonderful job. She took her time,…
posts.text:
Update: Check out the comment I just got from Alicia's Deals reader Garrett: "Just had my hair cut by Stephanie. She did a wonderful job. She took her time, asked a ton of questions about my preferred style, and even did a little extra tapering because she asked if I wore glasses. The cut looks great."
I've been getting e-mails from the Supercuts Training Studio for awhile now and finally had a chance to try them out today. If you'd like to sign up to be a SuperCuts haircut or coloring model, head over here to get on the mailing list. There are locations available in Scottsdale and Chandler.
Check out the e-mail they sent me this week:
"Attention!!! We are offering FREE haircuts in Scottsdale location this week!!!
At the Scottsdale LOCATION
10701 N Scottsdale Road
Wednesday June 20 10:15-11:30 and 1:00-4:00pm
Thursday June 21 10:15-11:30 and 1:00-4:00pm
Friday June 22 10:15-11:30 and 1:00-2:30pm
We have 3 stylists this week and really need models.
please send this to all your friends on social media!
Please DO NOT mention free haircuts at the front desk as that would confuse paying guests.
We are located in the back, first door on the right.
if you are interested in hair color, you can schedule an appointment if you come in for a trim. Please remember hair needs to be shoulder length or shorter, and color techniques available are limited.
We are looking forward to seeing you!"
I was a little bit nervous but my 13 year old son was badly in need of a haircut and since he's been asking for a buzz cut anyway we decided he could be a guinea pig for all of us. He ended up with a really nice looking haircut, no follow up buzz cut required. They took a lot of time with him and even did a hot towel treatment at the end. The whole process took about 30-40 minutes.
Here's some more information about being a hair model:
"By being a Model, you are helping to train new and experienced Cosmetologists who work at SuperCuts® Salons in your area in refresher courses or new techniques and procedures that they will take back to their Salon and improve the cuts and coloring services that they provide there. The Training Instructor will be coaching and inspecting what the quality of your services constantly.
As a Model, you should:
Prepare to spend more time than usual for your haircut or coloring. Be patient. Some haircuts may take between 30 to 60 minutes, and colorings may take more than twice the amount of time as you would normally expect.
Be open to giving and receiving feedback. Some of the training involves sales techniques so your stylist may be asking you questions, or recommending products. Be prepared to give constructive criticism to the Instructor and Stylist if you are asked, or if you feel it is necessary.
Please understand that you cannot purchase products when you are inside the Training Studio. The Studios DO not have a Cash Register, nor change. Come prepared. You MAY purchase products from the Salon if the Training Studio is located inside the Salon.
Gratuities are gratefully accepted by the Stylists for your services, but are NOT required. If you are going to tip, do it just as if you were inside your local Salon. Tips are not necessary for your instructors. Again, Training Studios are not licensed to sell products or handle money.
If you are going to bring children to the Studio, please make sure that you bring someone else along to watch them while you are in your session for their safety. Children should not play with the equipment or chairs, and should wait in the waiting area.
Yes, we encourage your children to get a haircut, but we ask that they should be able to sit still in the chair for a longer than normal period of time.
Complimentary Haircuts and Colorings are given on specific days and times. We DO NOT give haircuts and colorings outside of these times.
You are strongly encouraged to join your local Training Studio's Mailing List for advanced notice of days and times for upcoming classes."
Enjoy!

posts.text:
It’s time once again for my favorite deals at the grocery stores! If you’re new to the site (WELCOME!), I put together a post of shopping secrets at all of the valley grocery stores here. If you’re new to the site, this is a GREAT place to start!
Download the Ibotta app here if you haven’t already. I LOVE IT and think everyone should have it and now Bashas takes it! Bashas even lets you redeem the deals with your Thank You Card (no receipt required). You can get money back from your purchases at grocery stores including Sprouts, Fry’s, Safeway, Whole Foods, and more (think paper towels, dish soap, Blue Moon beer, Tyson chicken, Minute Maid juice, bread, eggs, orange juice, shredded cheese, pasta, yogurt, frozen veggies, bacon, tomatoes, green peppers, bananas, milk, ice cream, ketchup, mustard, peanut butter, frozen pizza, onions, avocados, lettuce, strawberries, popcorn, blueberries, broccoli, hot dogs, and lots more). This is a GREAT WAY to save on produce! You’ll also save at CVS Pharmacy, Target, Walmart, Walgreens, Costco, Sam’s Club, restaurants like Quizno’s, Home Depot and Lowe’s, Hallmark Stores, and more. It’s super easy to use once you get the hang of it and makes shopping way more fun. The cash back is in addition to any sales or coupons you have, and it goes right into your Paypal account (or you can get gift cards). You just redeem the offer and upload a picture of your receipt…super easy. I just got $27.20 back!
There are lots of new printable coupons. Click here to get to coupons.com and print off any coupons you think you’ll use. Bashas' will still double coupons this week (they're the only ones)! Save big on all kinds of things already on your list like Febreze, Oxiclean, Pampers, ice cream, dish soap, Pace picante sauce, Off insect repellent, Band Aids, and lots more!
Don’t forget that Walmart will match any ad (with few exclusions)! You DON’T NEED THE AD! You can use this list to help you score the best prices in one spot. Head over here to find out more about their Savings Catcher program that will make sure you’re saving big! I just got $9.20 back! Get Ibotta rebates and use coupons on top of that and you’re really saving cash! I’ve heard back from so many of you who love this!

posts.title: Pogo Passes are PERFECT for the Easter Basket! Still Just $39.98! Dbacks Game Days Have Been Added!
posts.excerpt: The POGO Pass are perfect additions to the Easter basket! You can still head over here and get one for just $39.98 with code ALICIA (everyone in the family…
posts.text:
The POGO Pass are perfect additions to the Easter basket! You can still head over here and get one for just $39.98 with code ALICIA (everyone in the family using a pass needs their own). We STILL haven't had our spring break (it's the week after Easter) and I'm looking forward to using our passes!
To make the deal even more exciting, if you buy or renew a pass in March (remember to use code ALICIA) you’ll be automatically entered to win 4 tickets to Wicked at Gammage!
I love that the Dbacks game days have been added! Check out what your pass includes:
Arizona Diamondbacks: One (1) ticket per game per pass holder for two (2) home games at Chase Field for the MLB Regular Season.
Available Hours
Pass holders can choose two (2) of the available Games for the 2015 MLB Regular Season.
Sun, 4/26 vs. PIT 1:10 PM
Tue, 5/12 vs. WAS 6:40 PM
Wed, 6/17 vs. LAA 6:40 PM
Fri, 7/24 vs. MIL 6:40 PM
Tue, 8/11 vs. PHI 6:40 PM
Fri, 10/2 vs. HOU 6:40 PM
Registration button appears on this page (2) weeks prior to game day. Must register your Pogo Pass to reserve tickets at will call. Login to your account for a list of your available passes.
Your pass will get you into Makutu’s Island in Chandler twice with your year-long pass (Monday-Friday). Tickets are usually $10 each.
Castles and Coasters: Each Pogo Pass holder recieves one (1) visit to Castles~n~Coasters for a *Silver Pass (worth $29.99). This includes unlimited rides and mini golf.
Each Pogo Pass holder receives general admission to the Phoenix Zoo two (2) times. To gain admission to the Zoo, simply present your Pogo Pass at the admission window. Some experiences require an additional fee. Admission to ZooLights and select special events is not included. An adult general admission is usually $20, so this is a $40 value for adults. There is a new baby orangutan that I can’t wait to visit! Head over here to see more adorable pics (or better yet grab your Pogo Pass and visit in person).
Sunsplash: Each pass holder can attend Golfland Sunsplash one (1) time. Your pass is good for one (1) SunSplash General admission ticket. Simply present your Pogo pass at Sunsplash Guest Service window to be scanned to obtain waterpark wristband. Sunsplash is closed for the season but since your pass is good for a FULL YEAR, you can use this next summer. A general admission ticket for adults is usually $29.99.
IDEA museum (used to be Arizona Museum for Youth): Each pass holder can attend i.d.e.a Museum Two (2) times during normal business hours (closed on Monday). Children 1 yrs of age and up are $8 admission if they do not have a valid Pogo Pass. Children are required to wear socks in play area. ** Excludes opening weekend (Fri, Sat, Sun) of opening exhibitions, 3 weekends a year. Simply present your Pogo Pass at admissions desk for entrance. Since admission is usually $8, this adds $16 of value to your POGO pass.
Enchanted Island: Your Pogo Pass is good for a Day Pass four (4) times at Enchanted Island Park Friday and Sundays during regular business hours. Not valid during Enchanted Island special events (I would call ahead before you go). Limited capacity, first come first serve. Some rides may require additional charge. A day pass is usually $17 for anyone under 54 inches, $10 for anyone over.
Sun Devil Athletics: Pogo Pass is a accepted for general admission tickets to ALL of the following ASU athletic home games: Women’s Basketball, Soccer, Wrestling, Volleyball, Gymnastics, Track and Field. **No need to pre-register for tickets to attend. Simply present your Pogo pass at will call or the front gate to gain admissions.
National Comedy Theater: Each pass holder can attend 2 shows. Please call for a reservation. Seating is limited. First come first serve. Note: Please honor your reservations. Reservations will be cancelled for those who are not in their seats 5 minutes prior to show. Tickets are usually $14 each.
Skateland: Each pass holder can attend Skateland two (2) times per month. Skateland has three (3) different locations available to pass holders. Simply present your Pogo Pass card at the front counter to gain admission to Skateland. Skate Rental not included. There are 3 locations (one in Mesa, one in Glendale, and one in Chandler).
Phoenix Rock Gym: Pogo Pass holders can attend Phoenix Rock Gym two (2) times. Simply present your Pogo Pass at the front counter to gain admission to Phoenix Rock Gym. Waiver required for 18 and younger. Limited capacity, first come first serve. *Climbing gear available upon request for $5.
Jump Street: Each Pass holder can attend Phoenix Jump Street two (2) times. Pass is good for a one (1) hour jump session each attendance. NOTE: This one is only available during normal business hours Mondays and Wednesdays.
Stratum Laser Tag: Pass holders can attend stratum two (2) times. Each pass holder receives one (1) complimentary game of laser tag each time they attend. Pass is valid for 12 months. NOTE: Pogo Passes may be used on Mondays and Wednesdays 4:30-close. Pogo Passes may not be used during school holiday breaks or Stratum’s designated holiday hours. No exceptions.
Tempe Paintball: Pogo Pass holders can attend Tempe Paintball one (1) time per month for 12 months that include gun rental, air, and 100 paintballs. Check for seasonal hours and scheduled groups or events before scheduling your visit. Keep in mind that all participants must be 10 years or older, and must sign a waiver before prior to entering the arena. Note: This is not good on Saturdays.
Arizona Rattlers: (1) One ticket per game per pass holder for three (3) Arizona Rattlers home games at the US Airways Center for the AFL regular season. There will be select games posted before the next regular season.
Fat Cats is coming to Gilbert soon and will be part of the POGO Pass (including bowling)!
Enjoy your passes and please note that venues are subject to change!

My tips to getting the best deals:
Competition almost always helps you. Get multiple quotes from multiple dealers. They all want to beat each other and you can get quotes online without leaving your home. I always ask for an out the door price (including tax and all fees).
Keep in mind that there might be secret incentives on the car you want. Secret incentives can be $1000-$6000 in addition to known rebates. Invoice is usually not the price the dealer actually paid for your car.
Remember the power of walking out. If a negotiation isn't going the way you want, leave!
Head over here to check out edmunds.com. They'll have dealerships competing for your business (and the whole process can be a lot easier). Remember, I always ask for the out the door price! If you can pay cash (or get a loan somewhere else if there aren't great financing options) you'll know exactly what you're paying. Try to negotiate the trade in separately from the car price.
It's a great time to go on vacation (between the busy summer and holiday travel times) and score deals! San Diego has over 100 KIDS FREE deals. Kids will eat free, stay free, even play free.

posts.title: Did You Buy at Least One Red Bull from 2002-2014? Get $10 from Their Class Action Lawsuit Settlement
posts.excerpt: I'm so glad so many are sharing this awesome deal that 99.9% of us will qualify for! Who hasn't had a Red Bull in the last 12 years?! If you’d like to “live…
posts.text:
I'm so glad so many are sharing this awesome deal that 99.9% of us will qualify for! Who hasn't had a Red Bull in the last 12 years?! If you’d like to “live life better for less” every single day, please “like” Alicia’s Deals on facebook, follow me on Twitter, and join the Alicia’s Deals e-mail list (I send one e-mail a day with the best deals around and you can unsubscribe at any time).
Here's a class action lawsuit most of us will probably qualify to be part of. Head over here to file a claim if you bought at least one Red Bull from January 1st, 2002 to October 3rd, 2014. You can choose to have a check for $10 mailed to you or approximately $15 of free Red Bull products.
Here's the legal language: "A settlement, set forth in a Stipulation of Settlement ("Stipulation"), has been reached in two class action lawsuits alleging that Red Bull North America, Inc., Red Bull Distribution Company, Inc., and Red Bull GmbH (collectively, "Red Bull"), misrepresented the functional benefits and safety of energy beverages marketed and distributed under the brand name Red Bull ®, including any variations, formats or line extensions thereof. Red Bull denies any wrongdoing or liability and while Red Bull believes that its marketing and labeling have always been entirely truthful and accurate, it confirms that all future claims about the functional benefits of its products will be medically and/or scientifically supported. The settlement will provide Class Members (as defined below) who timely submit a valid Claim Form (as defined in the Stipulation) with the option of receiving a cash payment or free Red Bull products."
So basically they made claims in their advertising that were not medically or scientifically supported.
You can see more about the claim here.

I saw this article about the seven best things to buy in July and thought it would be great to find real examples of deals!
Here we go...
1. Furniture. There are lots of summer clearance events going on. Right now you can save huge at the Living Spaces summer clearance event. I saw a few pairs of women's jeans at Old Navy for under $10.
